decisions.scope: Create one canonical owner for LWC TypeScript migration strategy, execution, validation, and rollback.
decisions.rationale: Local coverage had general LWC development and framework migrations but no version-aware TypeScript migration owner with deterministic project checks.
decisions.routing: Use only for JavaScript-to-TypeScript migration or migration audit; route greenfield LWC work and other framework migrations to existing owners.

decisions.scope: Add a dedicated evidence-bound ApexGuru result acquisition and triage workflow.
decisions.rationale: The existing Code Analyzer package did not distinguish remote ApexGuru source analysis, authenticated-org prerequisites, supported file types, evidence modes, and runtime-proof boundaries.
decisions.routing: Use devops/salesforce-code-analyzer to configure and run engines; use apex/apexguru-performance-analysis to validate and triage ApexGuru output.

decisions.scope: Extend the existing Code Analyzer skill for current v5 engine selection and ApexGuru handoff.
decisions.rationale: Deepening the established owner preserves routing and avoids a second overlapping Code Analyzer package.
decisions.routing: Run and configure Code Analyzer through the existing devops skill; delegate only ApexGuru-specific evidence triage to the new Apex skill.

decisions.target: existing canonical skills and historical sf-skills manifest
decisions.scope: Do not bulk-create one local package per upstream folder.
decisions.rationale: The baseline already tracks 89 historical forcedotcom candidates and the 1,039-skill corpus owns most current topics. Only verified net-new gaps should alter the catalog.
decisions.routing: Use upstream_radar for pinned deltas, then classify each candidate as ADD, DEEPEN, MERGE, STOP, DEFER, or REJECT before authoring.

attestation.clean_room: The governing license for the unavailable snapshot could not be established because current upstream signals conflict. Every accepted file is clean-room original work grounded in official Salesforce sources.
